resources.string: Choose what runs. Review every result. Android already maintains your device automatically; use these tools when you need them.
Custom plan. Review the selected actions and options below.
Profile-guided app compilation and Android storage maintenance. Duration depends on your apps and device.
Full app compilation and storage maintenance. Uses more time, power, and disk space. A charger is required.
Let independent actions run if an earlier action fails.
Cancellation stops upcoming work. A cache or storage request already accepted by Android may finish in the background.
Owner user only. Personal files and app data are preserved. Free memory and compilation coverage are not device health scores.
Full compilation requires charging and may take a long time. It can use additional storage; compilation stops if the device becomes too warm.
Only the selected actions will run. You can leave this screen and return to see progress.
This is the desired available storage, not the amount to delete. Android removes app caches only as needed. Apps may need to download cached content again.
Ask Android to reclaim app caches toward a free-space target. Off by default.
Ask Android to schedule filesystem maintenance, including supported GC/TRIM work.
Request compressed-memory compaction when supported by the kernel. Does not close your apps.
Compile installed apps with ART. Profile-guided compilation is the default; apps already optimized may be skipped.

Uses 14 days of owner usage: at least 1 hour of foreground use and opened within 7 days → speed; other recent use → speed-profile; older usage → verify. Unknown usage → speed-profile. Android 16 uses verify instead of quicken. Speed requires charging.
No apps compiled in this run yet.
No dexopt results in this run yet.
Requested filter and ART result for this run. Skipped means ART kept existing code; the requested filter may not have been applied. Verify does not force a downgrade of existing compiled code.
Showing the first 300 apps. All eligible apps are still processed.
